name: ggml CUDA on DGX Spark GB10: Gemma 3 4B QAT Q4_0 pp2048 d4096 (b7941)
methodology: MAINTAINER bench on one NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10), build 11fb327bf (b7941). CUDA backend, ngl 99, flash attention on, ubatch 2048, mmap off, direct-io on. pp2048 is prefill of a 2048-token prompt, batch 1, per-request, NOT aggregate. tg32 is batch-1 decode of 32 new tokens, per-request. Depth d=4096 is the same measurement after 4096 tokens of prior context (plain row is depth 0). Value is the published mean; stddev is in notes. Single device, unified memory, no tensor parallel.
notes: Official ggml DGX Spark table, not a forum paste. stddev +/- 34.29. File size 2.35 GiB, params 3.88 B. A concurrent sweep at batch 1 through 32 is also on the page; those figures are aggregate and are not this record. Distinct from the earlier third-party Spark gpt-oss-120b CUDA sweep (different build, lower tok/s).
